title: Incident Review - Database Outage
summary: Root cause: connection pool exhaustion during traffic spike. Mitigation: increased pool size, added circuit breaker, improved alerting. No data loss. Estimated downtime: 23 minutes.
decisions: Implement circuit breaker pattern on all partner integrations
Increase database connection pool from 100 to 200
Add proactive alerting for connection pool usage >70%
Review all third-party integration rate limits by Feb 10
transcription: [10:00] Lisa Wang: Incident review for database outage on Jan 22. Lisa Wang facilitating. Mike, can you walk us through the timeline? [10:02] Mike Torres: 14:32 - alerts fired for high connection count. 14:35 - database became unresponsive. 14:38 - failover initiated automatically. 14:55 - service restored. [10:05] Lisa Wang: Root cause? [10:07] Mike Torres: Connection pool exhaustion. We had a traffic spike from a partner integration that wasn't rate limited. Each request was holding connections too long. [10:12] Sarah Chen: Why didn't autoscaling catch it? [10:14] Mike Torres: Database connections don't scale horizontally. We'd already hit the max. [10:17] Jen Park: Was any data lost? [10:18] Mike Torres: No. Failover was clean. We verified data consistency post-incident. [10:22] Lisa Wang: Action items to prevent recurrence?

actions.text: Implement circuit breaker on partner API
Review all partner integration rate limits

risks.description: Partner may not implement proper rate limiting
Similar issues with other integrations not yet identified
